title: Queue-led retro tooling, native engines and reverse-engineering pass
summary: Add 13 reviewed projects spanning Saturn recompilation, 6502 archaeology, native Z80 engines and modern retro-development tooling; retain five explicit non-promotions.
notes: CPU audit queue: `python tools/cpu_audit_queue.py --limit 20` returned zero unresolved source/target CPU areas before selection, so no architecture field was filled merely to satisfy a quota. Queue-led review covered 13 repository candidates and three additional non-promotions. Fresh-search repository queries `Acorn Electron disassembly reassembly`, `PC-98 source reconstruction`, and `Atari ST homebrew source` returned no repositories; rotated code searches `Electron disassembly`, `PC-98 decompilation`, and `Atari ST homebrew` were then screened. The PC-98 route promoted REA and deduplicated ReC98; the Atari route promoted Atari Dev Studio after primary review corrected the scope to 2600/7800; the Electron route was noise-only. No candidate was independently compiled or executed.
